reason: I know my regulars by name, I don't need a QR code to tell me who comes back, and loyalty rewards feel like a chain thing. I already pay for Wox and a card terminal, and another system plus another per-transaction fee is just more for my manager to look after.
objection: Why pay 59 lari a month plus extra card fees for something on top of the POS and terminal I already have, when my regulars come because of me, not an app? Half my summer weekend guests are tourists I'll never see again anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged straight into my Wox/SQR so there's no second system, and the payment fee was no higher than my terminal's, and other owners I know showed me it brought real repeat visits or tourist bookings.
